title: The endomorphism tower of a finite symmetric group
summary: We consider the endomorphism tower of a monoid $M$, that is, the sequence of monoids End$_i(M)$ where End$_0(M)=M$ and for all $i\geq 1$, End$_i(M)$ is the monoid of all endomorphisms of End$_{i-1}(M)$. We show that for a finite monoid $M$ this sequence does not stabilise in a finite number of steps. Our focus is then on the case where $M=\mathcal{S}_n$, the symmetric group on a finite number $n$ of points.
